text: Love it!. Love this comforter and it does add a light weight which I love!

product_metadata.title: HIG Chic Comforter Set Queen Gray Lace Ruffled - Pintuck Pinch Pleat Design - Super Soft Prewashed Microfiber Lightweight - 3 Piece Bedding Set with Two Shams(Brianna-Queen,Gray)
features: UNIQUE PINCH PLEAT EMBROIDERY - luxurious pleated design features pinch style pleating technique. It is a simple and sophisticated way to enhance any bedroom's look.
ELEGANT RUFFLED LACE - Added Ruffled Fringe both on comforter and sham, very delicate , pretty looking and gorgeous. It could be a great decor used in master room, guest room or spare room.

PREMIUM PREWASHED MICROFIBER - Made of 100% pre-washed microfiber. Wrinkled is the natural texture, not a used product. It provides you unparalleled cotton-like softness and excellent experience and comfort all night.
HIGH QUALITY FILLING - 100% polyester filling, perfect science match of 3d and 7d fiber combination, which make the comforter ultra soft, always fluffy, lightweight, and warm enough.

THREE PIECE SET - 1 Queen comforter size 86"(W)*90''(L)+3''(Ruffled Fringe) and 2 pillow shams size 20"(L)*26"(W)+2"(Ruffled Fringe). We recommend King size for queen bed if you like bedspread effect. Due to the delicate nature of the design, these items are dry clean only.
